summary: kaggle P2-SWEEP v1 (pm1-qcc-invsqrt-p2sweep-20261025-1) FAILED: IndexError tuple index out of range in table_poly_model.quantise. Root cause: sweep2.py's un-tuned (A,deg) fallback synthesised a degree-2 W/D pair (2 elements) for deg=3 combos (A=7/9, deg=3 have no tuned point), which table_poly_model.quantise indexed into with des.D[des.deg-1] -> out of range. Fixed by making the fallback emit W/D of length matching deg (deg 2 -> 2, deg 3 -> 3); re-pushed as -2 which completed.
root_cause: sweep2.py fallback W/D synthesis not length-matched to deg; table_poly_model.quantise assumes len(D)==deg.
